mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, title, description, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, uploaded_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM course_materials WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, course_id, title, description, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, uploaded_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM course_materials WHERE file_url = #{fileUrl} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, course_id, title, description, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, uploaded_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM course_materials WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_materials ( course_id, title, description, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, uploaded_by ) VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{uploadedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE course_materials SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
